body:
## Summary
- Place the logo, games, and scoreboard on one header row with the account actions, including during a match.
- Gate the layout behind the `header-arrangement` control point so the previous two-level header stays in place until the flag is on.
- Record `arcade_web_header_views_total` and `arcade_web_header_nav_clicks_total` when the unified header is shown and used.

## Test plan
- [ ] With the flag on, confirm logo, games, and scoreboard sit on one row on the lobby, scoreboard, and a match.
- [ ] On a phone-width viewport, confirm a player still fits on one line and an admin can slide the row to reach log out.
- [ ] With the flag off, confirm the logo stays on its own row and games and scoreboard stay below it.
- [ ] Confirm header view and nav-click metrics are emitted when the unified header is used.


Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
title: Put logo, games, and scoreboard on one header row
